title: NET-共同维护-WebTTY路由验收
objective: 审计 Workbench/WebTTY 在 USB reverse、LAN、NetBird、DuckDNS、5G 下的 best-route 选择和验收链。重点检查 phone-webtty-route-probe、mobile-ai-route-prewarm、codex-webtty-perf-summary、network-scenario-monitor 的职责边界，列出哪些状态文件足以验收，哪些必须通过 ADB phone-side probe。返回 status、route_matrix、evidence_files、gaps、recommended_acceptance。
constraints: 不要用Fedora本机curl替代手机证据

workflow_rules.text: Do not run Mobile AI Browsh as a fresh `browsh` process for every ttyd WebSocket client. Opening `/browsh` in a second tab/window then starts a second Browsh, it exits quickly, and the page enters reconnecting. Keep `~/.local/bin/mobile-ai-browsh-entry` tmux-backed on session `mobile-ai-browsh`, and

Do not use router Web form as the first write path when it times out. Prefer SSH `/usr/sbin/nvram` plus `/sbin/restart_firewall`. Do not turn `opencode-18910-local.service` into a second `opencode serve` backend for review workspaces. `18910` is the LAN/public Web entry and must remain a proxy to `4

Do not treat Sway workspace/window flicker or drifting windows as a pure compositor bug before checking remote-input and auto-window churn. On this host, Sunshine creates `48879:57005:*_passthrough` input devices, and `adb-phone-keepalive.sh` must not auto-start Sunshine unless `ADB_PHONE_KEEPALIVE_

Do not repeatedly hammer Windows SSH for phone USB ADB fallback after OpenSSH returns `Exceeded MaxStartups` or immediate `Connection reset`. Windows is reachable at TCP level, but `sshd` is refusing sessions; restart Windows OpenSSH Server or wait for stale unauthenticated sessions to clear.

Do not assign Haven profile 2 (`OpenCode 18910`) as `mcp_tunnel_endpoint_profile_id`; it becomes a headless tunnel with no terminal.
